user.title: Livoltek Portal
user.description: Pick the portal your account belongs to. If you are unsure, sign in on the web and read the address bar: it starts with evs for EMEA, www for International, and aa for Asia.

credentials.title: Sign in
credentials.description: Use the same account you sign in to the Livoltek portal with. Home Assistant stores a hash of your password so it can renew the session on its own.

captcha.title: Verification code
captcha.description:
The portal asked for a verification code. Confirm your sign-in details and type the characters shown below.

![Captcha]({captcha_url})

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: Each selected inverter becomes a device with its own sensors.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between cloud polls. Values under 60 seconds increase the risk of rate limiting without producing fresher data.

names.title: Name your devices
names.description:
This name becomes the prefix of every entity id, so pick something short you can type from memory in an automation. "Loft inverter" gives `sensor.loft_inverter_battery_soc`.

The default is the model name. Without a name here the portal's own label is used, which contains the inverter serial number.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Livoltek portal rejected the stored session for {account}. Enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected that account or password.
error.invalid_captcha: That verification code was not accepted. A new image has been loaded.
error.unknown_account: The portal does not know that account. Check the region you picked - accounts are not shared between the EMEA, International, and Asia portals.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Livoltek portal.
error.invalid_device_name: Enter a name containing at least one letter or digit.
error.duplicate_device_name: Two devices would produce the same entity ids. Give this one a different name.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Livoltek account is already set up.
abort.no_devices: That account has no energy storage devices.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Those credentials belong to a different Livoltek account than the one configured here. Sign in with the original account instead.

captcha_required.title: Livoltek sign-in needs a verification code
captcha_required.description: The portal asked for a captcha while renewing the session for {account}, which Home Assistant cannot answer on its own. Open the integration and sign in again to restore polling.
